name: Punching dagger

body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 17, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 142
Statistics
Cost 2 gp Weight 1 lb.
Damage 1d3 (small), 1d4 (medium); Critical x3; Range —; Type P; Special —
Category Light; Proficiency Simple
Weapon Groups Close
Description
A punching dagger’s blade is attached to a horizontal handle that projects out from the fist when held.
